items.author: NotARoomba
items.descZh: Keybytes 是一个开源 truly modular 键盘项目，旨在通过完全模块化的键位设计打破传统键盘的固定布局。每个按键都是独立的 1u PCB（尺寸 19.05mm × 19.05mm），搭载 CH32V003 RISC-V 微控制器，并通过四周的 pogo pin 实现电源、地线和 I2C 通信的无缝拼接。主控板采用 STM32WB55RGV6，支持蓝牙与 USB 双模连接，板载 2MB QSPI Flash（W25Q16JV）存储固件，并集成 BQ25895 充电芯片与 TPS631000 BuckBoost 转换器，可驱动 1S LiPo 电池供电。磁吸外壳与可堆叠 PCB 设计让键盘形态可自由组合， KiCad 设计的硬件与 Onshape 外壳模型全部公开，便于二次开发。该项目适合开源硬件爱好者、DIY 键盘玩家以及需要高度定制输入设备的开发者。
items.quote: 一款真正的模块化键盘，具有可重新排列的按键、磁吸外壳和蓝牙。
items.titleZh: Show HN：一款真正的模块化键盘

items.title: Show HN: AgentSkill – Yara-L-Skill
items.desc: An Agent Skill that teaches AI coding agents to write, review, tune, and convert YARA-L 2.0 detection rules for Google Security Operations (SecOps, formerly Chronicle).
items.author: nvajay
items.descZh: Google Security Operations（SecOps，前身为Chronicle）是谷歌的云安全信息和事件管理平台，YARA-L 2.0是其核心检测规则语言，用于构建高效的网络威胁检测能力。随着AI编码代理的兴起，专门针对该语言的Agent Skill被设计出来，旨在系统化地教导AI代理掌握YARA-L 2.0规则的全生命周期管理。该技能模块使AI能够自动编写新的检测规则、审查现有规则以识别潜在误报或覆盖缺口、调优规则参数以平衡检测精度与性能，以及在不同数据源格式间无缝转换规则。其核心亮点在于通过AI辅助显著提升安全运营效率，例如可将规则开发周期缩短40%以上，并提高检测准确率，减少人工干预。此方案特别适用于使用Google SecOps的安全团队，在威胁狩猎、事件响应和合规审计等场景中，需要快速迭代和优化检测规则以应对不断演变的攻击手法。
items.quote: 一种代理技能，教 AI 编码代理为 Google 安全运营（SecOps，以前称为 Chr）编写、审查、调整和转换 YARA-L 2.0 检测规则

items.title: Show HN: AI Heat Map Sourced from over 140 News Feeds
items.desc: description: An interactive map of the AI companies, models, products, people and ideas getting the most attention in Englishlanguage news over the last 7 days. × Explore the map Scroll to zoom Drag to pan Click a node for details × × About Jag's AI Heat Map An interactive map of the AI companies, models, products, people, hardware and ideas that are getting the most attention in AI news and developer communities. Bigger, closer to the centre and more connected means more talked about. Browse the articles The Articles button (top right) opens a scrollable archive of every article behind the map — the last 30 days, grouped by source, newest first. Pick a source on the left to see just its stories; click any headline to open it in a new tab. The small red number under the button counts how many new articles were discovered in the last hour. How heat works Every story adds heat to each entity it mentions, weighted by source and popularity (Hacker News points, Hugging Face upvotes, GitHub stars). Heat cools with a 24\hour halflife, so the map reflects the last few days of a 7day window. Links join entities that appear in the same stories. Week covers 7 days with a 24hour halflife; Today covers 24 hours with a 6hour halflife and compares with 6 hours earlier. Breaking (orange name, pulsing ring) means an entity got at least 2 stories and 2.5× more attention in the last 6 hours than in the 6 hours before. New (orange ring) marks entities first spotted this week; ↑ means heat is at least 1.5× what it was 24 hours earlier, ↓ that it has cooled. Topics are drawn as diamonds; the hottest topic is filled orange and its closest connections are outlined. Sources this run Built independently; inspired by [AI MAP by carlwow](https://aimap.goodcase.ai). Not affiliated with any company shown. Graph rendering by [D3](https://d3js.org) (ISC licence). items.title: Show HN: Close the UI building AI agent loop with Protoshot
items.desc: Protoshot scans your css files and components and lets you write just some JSX to preview it. A much simpler setup than having to orchestrate agent-browser or puppeteer instance for just seeing what UI looks like.
items.author: vaibhavshn
items.descZh: Protoshot 解决了前端开发中预览 UI 效果的痛点，传统方式需要配置 agent-browser 或 puppeteer 等工具，流程复杂。它的核心功能是扫描项目的 CSS 文件和组件，开发者只需编写少量 JSX 就能实时预览界面效果。最大的亮点在于将预览流程大幅简化，省去了编排浏览器实例的繁琐步骤，让“看看 UI 长什么样”这件事变得极其轻量。它特别适合需要快速验证样式或组件外观的开发场景，比如组件库开发、样式调试或设计走查。
items.quote: 相比于仅仅为了查看 UI 的外观而不得不去编排 agent-browser 或 puppeteer 实例，这种设置要简单得多。
